mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as lower rates reduce discount rates applied to equity cash flows and increase valuation multiples.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 50% of instances with FEDFUNDS < 3.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% (FEDFUNDS) signals a monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise month-over-month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals improving labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 50% of instances where UNRATE declines in the high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 115 signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 115), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) signals strong residential construction activity, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 50% of instances with HOUST > 2000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 50% of instances where PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index above 3.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation, which may trigger monetary tightening and reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
